records.part: Recurring preventive maintenance contract for JCI installed HVAC equipment and Metasys HVAC direct digital control (DDC) software
records.reason: JCI hardware and software are proprietary in nature. While some maintenance tasks can be performed by a non-OEM entity, most tasks must be conducted by JCI to prevent voiding warranties and interruption of service. Furthermore, only JCI can install and issue Metasys Software due to proprietary licensure.
